headline.caveat: committed Azure purchases, plus an option to contract up to ~1GW of additional capacity

realized_to_date.caveat: consumption ramping from 2026; amounts not disclosed

nature_md: Announced Nov 18, 2025 with the Microsoft (≤$5B) and NVIDIA (≤$10B) investments: Anthropic commits to purchase **$30B of Azure compute capacity**, with the ability to contract up to one additional gigawatt — running Claude on Azure infrastructure powered by NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems. In exchange Claude gets distribution across Microsoft's enterprise surface (Copilot family, Foundry), making it the only frontier model available on all three major clouds. Completes the pattern: each hyperscaler that invests in Anthropic simultaneously becomes its committed supplier.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Forward purchase commitment expensed as consumed; stacks with AWS (>$100B/decade) and Google TPU (tens of billions) commitments against a ~$30B run-rate — aggregate obligations that assume continued hypergrowth.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Azure books consumption revenue/backlog; Microsoft is simultaneously investor (≤$5B), supplier ($30B inbound commitment), competitor (OpenAI stake, Copilot), and distributor of Claude — four hats on one counterparty, each with different accounting.

events.title: Anthropic commits $30B to Azure; Claude lands on all three major clouds
